feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: In Colorado, a GOP candidate says his differences with Trump show he's with the voters
entry.summary: We look at Republican Congressman Jeff Hurd's campaign in Colorado, where he is using his breaks with President Trump as an asset in his bid for reelection.

entry.title: Politics chat: Trump announces a Greenland deal, bans more media from the White House
entry.summary: We look at President Trump's announced ban of some media outlets covering the White House, as well as what a big cash windfall might mean for Republicans in the coming midterm elections.

entry.title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow
entry.summary: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.

entry.title: Thousands of planned launches, terms of deal, worry some near Louisiana SpaceX site
entry.summary: State officials say the new SpaceX site will be a $100 billion investment and launch thousands of rockets. Lawmakers helped ease regulations and negotiations were covered under nondisclosure agreements.

entry.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthis tried to attack its capital
entry.summary: Saudi Arabia on Saturday said that Yemen's Houthi rebels tried to attack Riyadh with a ballistic missile, the first time the Saudi capital has been targeted since the escalation in fighting with the Iran-backed rebels opened a new front in the Iran war.

entry.title: The high stakes drama a reporter has seen covering the UN General Assembly
entry.summary: Over the years NPR's Michele Kelemen has seen high stakes diplomacy play out at the UN General Assembly.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
entry.summary: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."

entry.title: Week in Politics: Trump bans news outlets; Iran War; mail-in voting; interest rates
entry.summary: The Trump administration was frustrated both home and abroad this week.

entry.title: Trump says he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
entry.summary: The president chalked the ban up to what he called unfavorable coverage, and he threatened that bans on other media companies could be coming.

entry.title: White House withdraws nomination of Lance Schroyer to lead ICE
entry.summary: President Trump's nominee to lead U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement was former Oklahoma state trooper Lance Schroyer. Three months after tapping him for the job, his name is being withdrawn.
